name: MSGT fast RAM restore and asynchronous continuation transport

scope.policy: Restore a valid RAM checkpoint promptly. If fresh recording cannot be admitted, skip only the new recording and report it; do not wait for storage or weaken source retention.
scope.file_compatibility: Ordinary existing v1-v3 headers with zero dependency words remain accepted by their existing version/capability gates. Required-branch headers use file version 3, the continuation capability and a permanent CRC-covered dependency tag. An update cannot treat a required-branch file as ordinary.

ownership.cache_lines: Request and payload lines remain PPC-owned; response lines remain ARM-owned. Each side flushes only its own lines. Request/payload identities are copied and validated before ownership transfer.
ownership.live_writer: The current FIL and its pending payload banks belong to the old run until an exact primary ACK says otherwise. A timeout or missing ACK is never permission to reuse banks or release a different run.
ownership.atomic_job: The exact 96-byte branch descriptor is copied to ARM-owned PREP union storage after warm FIL consumption. Background source checks and parent/child holds read that clone, never a subsequently reused BRANCHBOX payload.
ownership.failed_handles: A failed close keeps the exact FIL and active=2. A replacement FILE cannot zero it. Exact original FILE ownerSequence cancellation may retry close; only successful close permits replacement.
ownership.union_alias: TracePrepare.file and TracePrepare.link.file both start at offset zero. TraceLinkFileAlias checks this at compile time. Failed map cleanup closes the same FIL through either view; its branch/path union is not reused while open.
ownership.source_holds: While the async map is pending, its cloned parent and child identities block retained-source deletion. RELEASE of the live child does not cancel publication of an edge that may still be required.

wire.byte_order: All words are big-endian unsigned 32-bit; structures and cache-line offsets are unchanged.

preconditions: Owned active nonfailed recording writer in this boot
No prior retired FIL or recovery operation
At least one acknowledged complete chunk
Latest published FENCE receipt sequence equals old primary ACK and matches old header hash
FENCE, complete boundary, file size, canonical path and full header all validate
primary_7_RETAIN.success: Transfer the owned old FIL to the existing third slot without closing, syncing or renaming in the foreground. ACK uses phase DISCARDED=5/error=0 to mean old payload ownership was released; it does not mean the retained source is deleted or durably SAVED.
primary_7_RETAIN.refusal: ACK with BUSY=8; old owner and payloads remain authoritative.

primary_8_CONTINUE.requirements: An exact associated branch op5 and a fresh READY PREP3 file are mandatory. There is no cold-open fallback. Child and old run differ; branch, warm owner, boot, game, capabilities and primary sequence must match. Recovery, an occupied retired slot or another active map refuses admission.
primary_8_CONTINUE.commit: Validate before consuming the warm FIL. Park retained old source or detach only proven-unreferenced old source, then install the child and immutable dependency header. Publish the adopted child tuple before the primary success ACK.
primary_8_CONTINUE.before_transfer_refusal: Nonzero primary error, associated response owner=0; do not change the authoritative old writer or reuse its banks. An exact validated op5 is the only exception to the usual branch-pending retirement exclusion.
primary_8_CONTINUE.after_transfer_failure: Associated response identifies the child even if its first header seek/write fails. Failure must never report owner=0 after adoption.

branch_5_ASYNC_CONTINUE.payload: Exact 96-byte MsTraceBranch: new child identity, selected parent prefix and FENCE, ownerKind=FORK(0x464F524B), ownerId=1, ownerGeneration=1, reserved=0. The overloaded request nonce is a preserve flag, not the parent nonce; actual parent nonce is in the payload.
response_words: reserved[0]=adopted child run or 0 before-transfer refusal
branch_5_ASYNC_CONTINUE.pending_status: 0x100 means ownership accepted and map publication pending, never durable success.
branch_5_ASYNC_CONTINUE.terminal_status: 0 only after exact source proof and durable verified map publication. Nonzero is a terminal recording/dependency failure; RAM practice may still succeed. Legacy branch operations leave reserved[0..2] zero.

operations.3: CANCEL exact run and original FILE ownerSequence, capabilities=0

new_phase.10_LINKING: Consumed warm slot temporarily holds the async map FIL and cloned descriptor. New FILE/CANCEL requests return BUSY; HELLO still reports progress.

permit.1_READY: Ordinary safe-play grant: warm FILE/cleanup, ordinary retirement and required metadata may run.
permit.2_METADATA: Only an existing async map plus its exact retained parent may progress. It never admits speculative warming or ordinary unreferenced-tail deletion.
permit.guards: Reject unknown flag bits, queue over 0x40000, stale/malformed grant, active read or recovery. Existing pending writer/read/export/branch priority, DI quiet window, fresh-register preflight, no in-flight DI and no pending completion still apply. PPC metadata eligibility is separately limited to a fully loaded stable offline scene with headroom and no replay/freecam/warp/disk/watch conflict. Menu/native pause/FrameAdvance hold may qualify.

u32_offsets.60: existing FNV hash of header bytes 0..59

permanent_dependency_header.shape: All dependency words zero is ordinary. Otherwise exact BRCH, nonzero parent tuple different from child, continuation capability, PRV1 and flags 0x23 are required. Partial or unknown tags fail closed.
permanent_dependency_header.immutability: The required tag and parent tuple are never cleared by pending-to-durable progress. FENCE header hashes remain immutable.
permanent_dependency_header.reader: A tagged child needs its exact final committed .msgb Fork edge, exact child/header/game/capability/parent identity and completed parent DONE source. Pending .mbpt alone is insufficient. Logical graph resolution separately validates every ancestor and rejects cycles; sourceRead does not recursively invoke generic admission.
permanent_dependency_header.export: Raw self-contained exporter rejects BRCH headers at append and commit. Logical flattening creates a new ordinary self-contained header with all dependency words zero.

retained_parent_background.complete_boundary: If a chunk header is active, use its chunkOffset; otherwise use response.bytes. Preserve all earlier acknowledged complete chunks and every earlier durable FENCE, not just the checkpoint selected for loading.
retained_parent_background.partial_tail: Only unacknowledged partial tail bytes may be truncated. No retired service reads the old producer buffers after transfer.
steps: Check/seek complete boundary; truncate only partial tail if present
Write valid DONE footer with acknowledged chunk count and exact completed stored block count
retained_parent_background.metrics: Footer max/total compression timings may include work on a discarded incomplete tail; these are profiling fields. Stored block count subtracts partial-tail blocks exactly.
retained_parent_background.nonce_rule: Only retained same-boot live-writer ownership derives the actual nonce from the boot response. Ordinary retirement keeps its original nonce field. Mode-aware helpers never interpret footer metrics as identity or overwrite them with preservation flags.
retained_parent_background.failures: Truncate/footer/sync/rename failure preserves source; close failure preserves a distinct failed-retained FIL phase. A dependent map receives a terminal error rather than waiting forever. Never fabricate DONE or delete a retained source.

steps: Wait for retained parent to finish; fail if it reaches a terminal retained error
Validate exact completed parent and selected FENCE
Check existing final map read-only; only exact identical bytes may succeed
map_publication.cache: Pause reference-cache scans for the whole active map job so no partial temporary map poisons the negative proof. Increment reference generation on temporary creation; update the known parent summary only if the prior generation remains complete and current. Genuine malformed partial maps conservatively prevent negative deletion proofs.
map_publication.no_early_publish: Pending ownership ACK, valid-looking temporary map or source PART never equals durable branch success. Save/export/watch/checkpoint publication barriers remain until the exact committed edge is acknowledged.

stale_bank_transition.marker: Child before first chunk only: nonzero permanent parent, ackChunk=0, no active header, saved chunk.sequence=0 and saved chunk.run=known old run.
stale_bank_transition.rule: Ignore only that exact old run descriptor while waiting for PPC ownership ACK. Inspect incoming candidate locally before replacing the marker; do not hide arbitrary wrong-run descriptors. First validated child candidate removes marker.
stale_bank_transition.lifetime: Independent of map completion. PPC clears both mailbox descriptors after exact adoption ACK and before publishing child chunk 1. Refusal leaves the old bank ownership unchanged.

memory.note: Current ARM ABI measurements; compile-time fit/alias checks enforce bounds. No new capture arena, source bank, recovery arena, stack reservation or reader slot is borrowed.

tests.arm_async: scripts/test_ghost_trace_async.py: 21 cases, including exact-owner cancellation, partial-tail finalization, refusal/adoption identities, failed close/rename/source, required orphan rejection, stale banks, reference cache and metadata-only grant exclusions.
tests.integration: Real PPC producer/ARM and native manual RAM-load integration are maintained separately by producer/root; host tests do not claim Wii wall-clock speed.
